Axiom: Default dispatch is `polish: off` — report only CRITICAL and MAJOR (production-threatening logic / security / contract / alignment defects). MINOR / INFO never drive the loop or the verdict; they ride along in a separate non-blocking list ONLY when the operator asks for nits ("шлифуй" / "polish"). A clean artifact with a pile of suppressed nits is still CLEAN — do not let polish noise stall the loop.
